summary: Iter35 backend test of Ibn Khaldun (falsafa/inclassables) R2 sync fix. 3/6 tests pass. Course r2_prefix + resources listing + audio r2_key linkage OK. FAIL: (1) /audios/{id}/stream-url returns empty stream_url because migration v15l only sets r2_key/r2_audio_key while the /stream and /stream-url endpoints read file_key — user cannot listen to either episode. (2) Bibliography label is still the generic fallback 'Bibliographie sélective' — the DB-registered course-scope biblio does not go through _extract_biblio_title (only auto-detected biblios do).

critical.issue: Both Ibn Khaldun episodes return stream_url='' / 404 'Fichier audio non disponible'. audio docs have r2_key='cursus-a-falsafa/inclassables/ibn-khaldun-philosophie/Falsafa-ibnKhaldune-episode{1,2}.m4a' and r2_audio_key set to the same, but file_key is None. The two endpoints (server.py:1945 and :1989) only look at a.get('file_key'), so playback is broken. Migration v15l (line 5478) only fills r2_key, never file_key.

Bibliography (bibliographie_ibnkhaldune.docx) is returned with the generic fallback label 'Bibliographie sélective'. The dynamic title from the DOCX (_extract_biblio_title, server.py ~6906) is only invoked in _autodetect_meta (line 7668), not for DB-registered biblios. Since the course-scope biblio is registered via seed/migration with label='Bibliographie sélective', the real DOCX title never surfaces.

minor.issue: Both episodes still have is_placeholder=true even though real R2 audio was linked by v15l. Migration should flip is_placeholder=false when a real file is bound.

Contexte_ibn-khaldun.docx is not surfaced in /resources by design (server.py:7731 explicitly skips 'contexte_*'). Review request expected it here — either update the request expectation or expose Contexte as a separate resource type. Verified it IS accessible via the article rendering pipeline.

action_items: In migration v15l (server.py ~5478), also set file_key (and audio_url if used) to the same r2_key so /stream-url and /stream can serve the file. Alternatively, update /audios/{id}/stream-url and /audios/{id}/stream to fall back to r2_key or r2_audio_key when file_key is missing.
Flip is_placeholder=false in v15l when a real .m4a is linked.
Make _extract_biblio_title also run for DB-registered biblios in /courses/{slug}/resources (server.py ~7625), OR store the extracted title in the DB record at seed time so the label is dynamic.
Clarify whether Contexte_*.docx should appear in /resources (currently intentionally excluded).
critical_code_review_comments: Two parallel key names (file_key vs r2_key vs r2_audio_key) on the audios collection cause confusion. Unify to a single canonical field or centralize the resolution in a helper.
Migration v15l is one-shot and does not maintain the invariant when r2_prefix changes later — consider re-running on prefix update.

Biblio title extraction is duplicated logic paths: fallback filename label + optional DOCX real title. The label produced at ingest time is authoritative and hides the dynamic value — consider single source of truth.

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes v15l to set file_key (or endpoint fallback), rerun /app/backend/tests/test_iter35_ibn_khaldun_r2.py — expect all 6 tests to pass. Streaming test uses /api/audios/{id}/stream-url and expects a non-empty stream_url. Biblio dynamic title test expects any label != 'Bibliographie sélective'.
rca of the issue: Migration v15l writes only r2_key on audio docs, but the streaming endpoints (server.py:1945, 1989) require file_key. Since v14 seed inserts these audios without file_key and v15l does not backfill it, /audios/{id}/stream-url returns {stream_url:'', file_key:null, source:'fallback'} and /stream returns 404. Fix: in v15l, use `{'$set': {'r2_key': key, 'file_key': key, 'r2_audio_key': key, 'is_placeholder': False}}`.
